chapter: Movies and the Los Angeles scene
title: Appearing in Stormy Weather with Fats Waller
summary: Stewart played in the Fats Waller sequence of Stormy Weather, his only time playing with Waller, whom he found comical and wonderful.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Yeah, and -- Hell's A'Poppin' -- let's see. I was just wondering, I was thinking about another picture that Slim wasn't with me that I made with Fats Waller.
Oh, which one was that?
That was called Ain't Misbehavin'. (viz. below)
Oh, you made -- that was a film!
The movie.
Was it a -- was it a short film, or was it --
It was a short.
A short. (Inaudible).
(Interruption.)
So actually the movie wasn't Ain't
It was Stormy Weather.
And you were -- you were in the -- let's see. I think there were two sequences that Waller was in.
I was in the one with Waller and I think Rex Stewart was in that. (No)
Now, there's a scene in there, I think, where Zutty Singleton is playing drums.
Zutty, he was on drums.
And there's some scene that takes place in this cafe or something.
Yeah.
And I think he -- yeah, I don't remember which song offhand he plays in there, but I think he does play 'Ain't Misbehavin'.'
Ain't Misbehavin'.
In that sequence -- did you know -- did you know Waller well?
Waller? Fairly well. That was around, that was the first time I have really met him.
Oh, was it in the movie?
Yeah.
How did -- what -- how did he strike you?
Oh, he was quite a fellow. He was comical. Even in real life he was a very wonderful person.
And I was so glad to get with him to play, you know, (inaudible) with him.
What did you think of his musicianship in comparison to, say—
Tremendous, yeah. He played that piano and organ, you know.
Did you play with him in any situations other than that movie?
Well, no, I think that was the only thing.
That's the only time you had a chance to play with him?
That's the only time I ever had a chance to play with him, yes.
Because he didn't -- like he died some months, not very long after that movie.
Not too long after that. And he was really young. I think he was around 48, like that, when he passed. [ed. - 39]
Yeah. He was young. Like what did -- I mean were you around that production as it was made? Were you, I mean were you around it much, or did you just go in and do that particular sequence?
Well, I just went in and did that particular segment of it. And I may have stayed around, oh,
for another portion of it. But I wasn't around too long.
